book.name: Mbouŋ to Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content.text: Ighaze tamtoghon to Maaron tilup lolodi inim ee moghon itaghon ŋgar to toŋvetaz, nene paghuna,
ve igham lolood poia kat. Yo 17:23; Ro 12:10

content: to tiliŋi izala Aron daba, ve ireer izi itaghon aze oro, le itaghon nonogiiŋa toni le ireer malmali izila pa aghe.

content.text: Ŋgar to lolood ee moghon, nene inimale waam tiina izi pa lolooz to tigharau ndug Zion, inimale waam to izizi pa lolooz Ermon.
Onoon kat, ighaze yes to ndug Zion tilup lolodi inim ee moghon, nene pale Yoova ighur poia toni iza todi.
Nene nepooŋ poia to iseeŋga itaghoni taghoni gha ila.

footnotes.text: Saveeŋ to ŋgoreeŋ vuzi poia, nene iza to poia to Maaron. Ve waam, nene iza to nepooŋ poia to ye igham pait.
